resourceRoot: Assets/Resources/Art/GeneratedEquipment/Family (planned; outputs remain in D validation directory)

armor.side: front source or horizontal mirror for opposite side

resourcePathNote: resourcePath values are the intended Unity Resources-relative destinations; generated PNG files remain in D:\Unity\AshfallArtValidation\equipment-family-textures.

cell_key_rules.GunSeries: cell=gunClass*4+series, six classes x four series; maker from sheet name
cell_key_rules.DistinctEquipment accessories: existing bounds contain 30 cells, mapped as slotIndex*6+attachment; maker from sheet name
cell_key_rules.BespokeLegendaries: cells 0..4 gun variants, 5..9 armor variants; maker from sheet name; catalogIndex=makerIndex*5+local index

resourcePlan.strategy: Use existing Resources source sheets directly; crop each cell with shaderSampleUv. Keep individual PNGs in the D validation folder for QA only.
resourcePlan.sampleRule: Centered UV range with width and height divided by 1.05 expands visible image content by 5% on the projection surface.
